note: Only soil-moisture edges onto composition are ordination-axis correlations (effect null). Water-table / water min / water dif edges excluded (not soil moisture); e60 is richness, not composition.
No trampling/recreation cause; winter road clearances and experimental disturbance treatments are not visitor recreation.
No logging edge onto compaction/bulk density/structure; e19 soil loading and e35 forest-to-fallow conversion are not timber harvest.
Weir/instream structure edges target fish habitat or habitat complexity, not mammals; e8 windrows are not in-stream structures.

Excluded Shannon/structural diversity (not species number), e34 season-of-clipping contrast, e35 neighbor control (method unstated), e7 plantation clearing, and e40 defoliation mowing of the seeded community itself (not competing vegetation); including e40 would make it mixed.
Fish edges use calendar year / passage of time in reserve or monitoring series, not time since disturbance or stand age; time-since-recovery edges target copepods.
No temperature cause onto predation/seed consumption/damage; e7 browsing edge has restoration treatments as cause.
Methane edges use water table position/depth (not soil moisture per strict rule) or soil anoxia; e1 inundation targets CO2. Candidates look incomplete.
e5 counts trout stocking into a lake; crayfish (Orconectes) introduction edges excluded as invasive introduction, not reintroduction/stocking; e3 diatoms are not invertebrates.
Scarification edges target soil nutrients/temperature; e35 dune vegetation removal is not site preparation.
